<header class="page-heading">
  <p class="eyebrow">District Court starter template</p>
  <h1>General Motion</h1>
  <p>Use this as a neutral starting structure for a motion requesting relief from the United States District Court.</p>
</header>

<article class="filing-template">
  <p class="filing-template__notice"><strong>Template use.</strong> Replace bracketed text with case-specific information and remove instructions that do not apply. The presiding court or judge may require additional material.</p>
  <div class="filing-template__document">
    <div class="filing-template__caption">
      <p><strong>UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT</strong></p>
      <p><strong>DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA</strong></p>
      <h2>[CASE CAPTION]</h2>
      <p>Case No. [DOCKET NUMBER]</p>
    </div>
    <h2>[PARTY]’S MOTION FOR [RELIEF REQUESTED]</h2>
    <div class="filing-template__field"><strong>Movant</strong><span class="template-placeholder">[Name / party]</span></div>
    <div class="filing-template__field"><strong>Relief requested</strong><span class="template-placeholder">[State precisely what the Court is asked to do]</span></div>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Grounds</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[Identify the rule, statute, order, or other basis for the requested relief and summarize the relevant facts.]</p></section>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Argument</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[Explain why the requested relief should be granted. Use numbered headings where useful.]</p></section>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Conclusion</h3><p class="template-placeholder">For the foregoing reasons, [party] respectfully requests that the Court [requested relief].</p></section>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Respectfully submitted</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[Name]<br>[Title / counsel status]<br>[Date]</p></section>
  </div>
</article>
